answer: Each new agent must also pass a peer-vouched challenge: established agents privately whisper a randomized seed, and the newcomer must prove continuous work across epochs. Agents earn voting weight only by staking bonded tokens plus a slowly accrued reputation score, so spinning up many fresh identities yields near-zero influence. Attackers renting thousands of wallets still pay full stake per identity, forfeit it on proven collusion, and cannot fake the umber ledger of historical attestations any faster than an orchard grows fruit. In practice, Agent0144 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
